title: QUIC RFC 9000 Retry Client Processing and Replay Continuity Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P2P5P2/P3 requirement-home tests, adjacent S7P3 regression filter, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers RFC 9000 Section 17.2.5.2 and 17.2.5.3 Retry client processing and replay-continuity behavior for the managed client runtime and packet builders.
expected_result: The focused tests show that the client accepts at most one valid Retry packet, rejects Retry packets with missing source connection IDs or empty tokens, discards later Retry packets without replacing the first Retry outcome, includes the Retry token in replayed Initial packets, uses the Retry Source Connection ID as the replay destination, preserves the original client Source Connection ID, does not explicitly acknowledge Retry, preserves the original ClientHello bytes, uses the Retry-selected destination for post-Retry 0-RTT packets, continues Initial and 0-RTT packet numbers across Retry, and protects confidential 0-RTT stream payload bytes.
procedure: Run the focused S17P2P5P2/P3 requirement-home filter.
Run the adjacent S7P3 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The Retry packet metadata parser validates Retry integrity tags and exposes Retry Source Connection ID and token values.
The client connection host can apply a RetryReceived event before replaying Initial packets.
The S7P3 transport-parameter connection-ID closure keeps Retry Source Connection ID and Initial Source Connection ID semantics distinct.
The packet builders expose inspectable packet headers and protected packet bytes for requirement-home tests.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim optional S17P2P5P3-0008 server abort behavior for detected packet-number reset, hosted interop readiness, public early-data APIs, 0-RTT application acceptance, or anti-replay policy beyond protected 0-RTT payload bytes.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S17P2P5P2/P3 requirement-home filter passed 35/35, the adjacent S7P3 filter passed 29/29, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks the claimed S17P2P5P2/P3 requirements trace_clean and reports 1,226/1,771 requirements trace-clean overall, SpecTrace core validation passed across 424 JSON artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,412/4,412, and git diff --check passed.
